_comment: Round-252 bilingual fixtures for Observability. Used by observability_describe_challenge.sh + challenges/runner/main.go to verify UTF-8 / non-ASCII text round-trips losslessly through every observability primitive (trace span attributes, metric labels, log message fields, health-check component names, analytics event properties). CONST-046 alignment (no hardcoded English-only assumption).

inputs.log_message: Здраво, свете! Операција је успешно завршена.
こんにちは、世界！操作が正常に完了しました。
inputs.component: データベース・プライマリ
inputs.event_name: ユーザー.アクション.完了

inputs.log_message: 你好，世界！操作已成功完成。

expected_invariants.byte_preservation: Non-ASCII bytes in span names, log messages, correlation IDs, component names, and event properties MUST be preserved verbatim through the production code path (no normalization, no transliteration, no replacement).
expected_invariants.metric_label_safety: Non-ASCII text routed through metric label values MUST NOT panic Prometheus label validation; label-key namespacing is the safe path.
expected_invariants.correlation_id_propagation: logging.ContextWithCorrelationID + logging.CorrelationIDFromContext MUST round-trip the non-ASCII ID via context.Context unchanged.
expected_invariants.health_component_name_preservation: health.Aggregator.Register stores the component name verbatim; the Report MUST surface the same bytes on Check().
expected_invariants.analytics_event_property_preservation: analytics.Collector.Track MUST accept non-ASCII property values without rejecting the event (NoOp + ClickHouse collector contracts both).
